rca of the issue: Brute-force 429 not triggered: in deployed env, request.client.host returns the k8s ingress IP, not the real client. The per-(ip:email) counter never accumulates because each request from the test machine may traverse different ingress workers, or—even if stable—the IP is shared with all other traffic and could be reset. Mitigation: parse X-Forwarded-For (first IP) for `ip`, or key the brute-force counter purely on the email being attacked.
